message.content: {"count":2,"rationale":"Deploy mfa:admin and mfa:dbadmin together. mfa:admin blocks authentication to both DC and ADFS, so neither admin_dc nor admin_adfs can become true. Then mfa:dbadmin blocks authentication to the database, fileserver, and backup, preventing every exfiltration technique even if CI secrets are stolen. No single control suffices: mfa:admin alone leaves the CI-secret route available, while mfa:dbadmin alone can be bypassed through DC or ADFS administration. Any other single control leaves the DC/ADFS route available: phishing supplies user credentials and bypasses user MFA, and segmentation alone can be bypassed by escalating an unpatched workstation or laptop."}
